events.what: Venice access fee (contributo di accesso) for day-trippers: 72 days from 26 March to 15 August 2027, mostly long weekends, generally 8.30 am to 4.30 pm. Overnight guests in Venice are exempt but must register.
events.effect: Rule change: pay or register before a day visit to Venice's historic centre

sources.title: Contributo di accesso: il calendario 2027

laws.rule: Venice charged day-trippers an access fee (EUR 5, or EUR 10 within four days of the visit) from 8:30 to 16:00 on 60 set days between 3 April and 26 July 2026; the 2026 trial has ended, and the minor islands were excluded.

layers.authority: Comune di Auronzo di Cadore (road to Rifugio Auronzo), published on the Dolomiti tourism site
layers.process: The toll road to Rifugio Auronzo (about 6 km, ending at 2,333 m below the Tre Cime di Lavaredo) can be driven only with an online booking. In 2026 the toll was EUR 40 for a car, EUR 26 for a motorbike, EUR 60 for a camper, EUR 80 or EUR 160 for a bus (up to or over 30 seats) (about A$63.56 for a car at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). The ticket covers 12 hours of parking from the chosen access time. The plate can be added until 11:59 pm the day before. Access can be suspended in snow or hazard. The page notes a shuttle-bus alternative from Dobbiaco (also booked online).
